before.scope: VirtualQueryEx metadata for resident private pages only; no process memory bytes read. Shared pages and nonresident-only regions are excluded.

snapshot.limits: Selected address ranges and NtCurrentProcess calls only. API sizes are not resident pages or net new commitment. Other allocation paths and incomplete stacks remain unresolved. Memory and event snapshots are not atomic.

after.scope: VirtualQueryEx metadata for resident private pages only; no process memory bytes read. Shared pages and nonresident-only regions are excluded.

interpretation: Newly observed means absent from the pre-attach resident-page map, not proven newly reserved. API byte counts are not net commitment. Fixed address ranges do not prove reservation identity after reuse. Observer memory is included.
